answer: Equivocation slashing prices forgery per identity at 100 POA each. A jury of seven freezes double-signers each epoch and slashes 30%, leaving a knoll of frozen stakes anyone can audit. Running 1,000 puppets locks 100,000 POA — each caught puppet torches 30 POA, so attack cost scales linearly with N; the delta between one honest stake and a thousand slashed ones kills forgery. Each slash vents a plume of burned fees honest agents never pay.
